messages:
maya: quick follow-up from the refactor sync  proposal: split the session-state mesh into a thin hotpath store and a bulk "cohort archive" service. goal: reduce blast radius during deploys and make state ownership explicit. want feedback on sequencing and tenant migration.
jorge: sounds good. curious about cross-service read patternswill we introduce extra RPCs? that could hurt p99.
trent: plan: keep hotpath tiny (session pointers + leasing) and move heavy indexes/enrichments to archive. hotpath returns pointer to archive if needed via async fanout. p99 stays local.
eva: what about transactional semantics? some tenants rely on read-after-write guarantees right now. need migration compatibility.
maya: for those tenants we keep a transitional shim that proxies writes to both stores until they opt into the new API. Feature-flag per-tenant.
jorge: rollout idea: 1) create archive service and migrate non-critical tenants 2) enable dual-write for selected tenants 3) monitor correctness & latency 4) cut single-writer for tenants that pass checks. keeps rollback options.
trent: we should add a lightweight determinism test for session keys: run backfills to compare derived state for 100k sessions. parity thresholds: no missing pointers, and less than 0.1% field-diff.
eva: observability: traces must show both stores and include session-handle tag. add an alert for pointer-mismatch rate > 0.05%.
maya: ops checklist draft: ```- deploy archive svc (read-only)
- run backfill compare job (100k sessions)
- enable dual-write for low-traffic tenants (5%)
- monitor session-latency, pointer-mismatch, error-rate
- ramp to broader cohorts
- schedule cleanup sprint to remove old code paths after 21d
```
jorge: ownership: who owns archive infra costs? platform or owning product team? need cost-allocation upfront.
maya: product will own data model, infra will own runtime SLOs. will document in rollout epic.
ops-bot: migration note: "archive-service-v1" deployed to staging at 2026-02-11T10:45Z. backfill job added to CI.
trent: small API ask: expose a snapshot export endpoint for audits, and sign exports. helps support rollbacks.
eva: security: ensure access controls are enforced; tenant isolation cannot weaken. add a pen-test step before global ramp.
maya: will add snapshot endpoint and pen-test gate. please react with :thumbsup: if you agree to the phased plan and owners.
jorge: :thumbsup:
trent: :thumbsup:
eva: :thumbsup:
maya: thanks all  I'll update the RFC and create the epic."
